recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7880; handle FHIR-41765 separately if a run includes resolved-but-not-applied terminology copyright cleanups.
issue_request: FHIR-7880 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request from the 2015 May ballot asking to add Coverage.relationshipToSubscriber (Coding) 0..1 to Coverage using a v3 relationship value set, because Claim.coverage.relationship described an attribute that applies outside the claim context.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-7880. Source history shows the requested move was applied in the legacy spreadsheet era: commit 9874f360497fb610204cb1aea808e8d78419c5ed removed the active Claim.coverage.relationship row and added Coverage.relationship, and later migration commits carried Coverage into the current StructureDefinition XML source.
additional_context: The current build uses source/fhir.ini's active coverage=Coverage resource entry. Later Published issue FHIR-17944 changed the same Coverage.relationship terminology from the original v3-style request to a specific subscriber relationship value set, renamed the concept to beneficiary relationship to the subscriber, and made the binding extensible. That later decision explains why the current source uses Coverage.relationship as a CodeableConcept bound to ValueSet/subscriber-relationship rather than the exact original relationshipToSubscriber/Coding wording. FHIR-41765 is a separate Resolved - change required copyright issue for the subscriber relationship terminology and was not treated as applied/published source-edit scope for this seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because current Coverage defines Coverage.relationship 0..1 as the beneficiary relationship to the subscriber with an extensible binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/subscriber-relationship, and current Claim.insurance.coverage points to Coverage without retaining the old Claim.coverage.relationship element.

related_jiras.note: Changed the same Coverage.relationship terminology and binding to the current subscriber-relationship value set, explaining the current representation.
Separate Resolved - change required issue about subscriber relationship copyright, not an applied/published decision for this seed.
